source: the $4500 string table (187 entries) and the print_inline sites

naming.note: all text and screen positions are read from the binary; the names and trigger descriptions are chosen in this script and match the rules in docs/spec/creatures.md.

encoding: uppercase ASCII, one byte per screen cell

fixed_strings.name: speak_with_whom
fixed_strings.printed_when: no creature in the room, or none adjacent

fixed_strings.name: come_back_tomorrow
fixed_strings.printed_when: gift-giver already spoken to today

fixed_strings.name: nothing_more_to_give
fixed_strings.text: I HAVE NOTHING MORE TO GIVE
fixed_strings.printed_when: gift-giver whose room has no object left on the ground

fixed_strings.name: no_response_line1
fixed_strings.printed_when: the selected speech or emotion slot is empty; also BUY/SELL/OFFER with no adjacent creature

fixed_strings.name: no_response_message
fixed_strings.printed_when: the selected message slot is empty

fixed_strings.name: pense_whom
fixed_strings.printed_when: no creature in the room

fixed_strings.name: pense_lacks_skill
fixed_strings.printed_when: spirit limit below 5

fixed_strings.name: pense_needs_energy
fixed_strings.printed_when: spirit energy is 0

fixed_strings.name: emotion_label
fixed_strings.printed_when: always, before the emotion word

fixed_strings.name: message_label
fixed_strings.printed_when: when the message half runs

fixed_strings.name: buy_needs_tokens
fixed_strings.printed_when: no token carried

fixed_strings.name: buy_too_heavy
fixed_strings.printed_when: carrying too much to add a purchase

fixed_strings.name: buy_granted
fixed_strings.printed_when: token spent; TAKE is now permitted for the stock class

fixed_strings.name: sell_prompt
fixed_strings.printed_when: the inventory cycle opens

fixed_strings.name: sell_nothing
fixed_strings.printed_when: the inventory cycle wrapped past the last item

fixed_strings.name: sell_refused
fixed_strings.printed_when: no free carried slot for the token

fixed_strings.name: sell_paid
fixed_strings.printed_when: the item became a token

fixed_strings.name: no_merchant_here
fixed_strings.printed_when: the creature is not a merchant

fixed_strings.name: offer_to_whom
fixed_strings.printed_when: no creature in the room, or none adjacent

fixed_strings.name: offer_what
fixed_strings.printed_when: the inventory cycle opens

fixed_strings.name: offer_nothing
fixed_strings.printed_when: the inventory cycle wrapped past the last item

fixed_strings.name: offer_refused
fixed_strings.printed_when: wrong item class for this creature

fixed_strings.name: offer_gate_accepted
fixed_strings.printed_when: a gate guard took the item

fixed_strings.name: door_is_locked
fixed_strings.printed_when: a gate guard blocks it and neither flag is set

fixed_strings.name: no_nid_offered
fixed_strings.text: NO ONE OFFERED YOU A NID
fixed_strings.printed_when: away from home without an offered nid

fixed_strings.name: not_offered_to_you
fixed_strings.text: IT WAS NOT OFFERED TO YOU
fixed_strings.printed_when: indoors, of an object whose class is not the one offered
